requirements_summary:
- Workload: primarily ticket summarization + tag extraction + macro execution (Zendesk). Some email threads (multithread summarization).
- Latency: interactive agent flows target < 200ms median for short summaries (single-turn), acceptable up to 800ms for full-thread summarization.
- Throughput: baseline 150–250 QPS, burst to 1k QPS for launches.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — prefers batching/caching recommendations to reduce token cost.
- Models: prefer starting with verified open models; consider quantized dedicated instances for cost at scale.
- Routing/fallback: must have deterministic fallback to smaller model under saturation; prefer model-variant routing by SLA tier.
- Integrations: two-way Zendesk API calls to apply tags and trigger macros, Freshdesk considered for smaller teams. Webhook-based streaming for new ticket events.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-tag accuracy dashboard, traceability from suggested tag -> applied macro -> ticket change event.
- Security/compliance: US data residency required, SOC2 + SSO/SAML mandatory, KMS-managed encryption at rest, retention controls (90 days default).
poc_plan_and_metrics:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): ingest 10k anonymized tickets; baseline manual tags vs model tags. Success: tagging precision >= 75% on intent, recall >= 70%.
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): integrate macro execution in sandbox; safety rollback and undo; success: 0 critical errors across 500 macro runs.
- Phase 3 (1 week): spike/resilience run (200 QPS sustained, 1k QPS bursts). Success: >95% requests served with fallback within SLA; median summary latency < 300ms.
- Acceptance: sign-off from security + ops + support leadership.
- Metrics collected: precision/recall per tag, agent time-savings (target 20% fewer manual tag ops), cost per 1k tickets.
